comment: ANCHOR: SINCE_CLOSE_NEW_PRINT_REBUILD_LQ1304_20261109 — LQ-20261107-1304 (operator 2026-11-08 19:44 ET: 'no print since Friday is an error'). --if-changed compared only change_state()'s signature, which carries the newest print per HELD name; a watchlist name's print did not move it, so a Sunday-night or after-hours print could sit in market_quotes_extended until the next forced rebuild. since_close_card.newest_print_since() and new_print_decision() rebuild (non-material: the summary is carried, no model call) when any held/watch name has a bar_end newer than the snapshot's own generated_at.
